messages:
Priya (security-docs): opening a small PR to clarify SOC2 audit-log retention scope and to add concrete SDK snippets for exports + redaction. No policy changes, just clearer wording and examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6999

Ana (Docs): can you confirm the default and who can request changes? want to avoid implying new promises.

Priya (security-docs): default retention = 90 days. Extended retention only by contract or authorized request (account owner, designated legal contact, or authorized compliance admin). Legal holds override TTL and persist until removed. No SLA change.

Ravi (eng): adding a minimal JS snippet and curl example for exports with redaction + legal hold:
```js
// JS SDK: request export with redaction and legal hold
await client.exports.create({
  tenant_id: 't-01',
  start_time: '2024-10-01T00:00:00Z',
  end_time: '2024-10-31T23:59:59Z',
  redact_fields: ['user_email'],
  apply_legal_hold: true
})
```

```bash
# curl export + redaction
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-01","start_time":"2024-10-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-10-31T23:59:59Z","redact_fields":["user_email"],"apply_legal_hold":true}'
```

link-bot: check failed 1: broken link to /compliance/audit -> suggest /security/compliance/retention.

Liam (Legal): wording edits: use neutral phrasing like 'Redwood retains' or 'Default retention is'. Add note that contractual terms supersede docs. Also ok to list authorized requesters.

Ana (Docs): I'll make the copy edits, swap the link, and add a one-line operational note: TTL enforcement runs hourly; legal_hold is applied immediately. Will push update shortly.

Priya (security-docs): thanks. Once updated I'll ask Legal for final sign-off and then merge.
